name: VMware Aria Automation Orchestrator
description: Workflows covering the VMware Aria Automation Orchestrator REST API operations most useful for orchestration automation: running and monitoring workflows, answering waiting user interactions, and reading actions, categories, configurations, and packages.

document.name: List Workflows
document.description: Lists workflows in the inventory. Use conditions=name={workflowFullName} or name~{keyword} to filter.

document.name: Get Workflow
document.description: Retrieves a workflow's definition, including its input/output parameters.

document.name: Run Workflow
document.description: Starts a new execution of a workflow with the given input parameter values.

document.name: List Workflow Runs
document.description: Lists the execution (run) instances of a workflow.

document.name: Get Workflow Run
document.description: Retrieves a particular workflow run's input parameters, initiator, dates, and run state.

document.name: Get Workflow Run State
document.description: Retrieves additional information about the state of a workflow run.

document.name: Cancel Workflow Run
document.description: Terminates a running workflow execution.

document.name: Get Workflow Run Logs
document.description: Retrieves the log messages generated during a workflow run.

document.name: Answer Workflow User Interaction
document.description: Provides input parameter values for a workflow run waiting on a user interaction.

document.name: List User Interactions
document.description: Lists user interaction objects. Filter with status=0 to return only waiting interactions.

document.name: Get User Interaction
document.description: Retrieves a single user interaction's inventory item details.

document.name: List Actions
document.description: Lists the actions available in the inventory.

document.name: Get Action
document.description: Retrieves an action's inputs, output type, name, description, version, and related links.

document.name: List Categories
document.description: Lists the categories used to organize workflows, actions, and other inventory objects.

document.name: Get Category
document.description: Retrieves a single category's details.

document.name: List Configurations
document.description: Lists the configuration elements (reusable named attribute sets) in the inventory.

document.name: Get Configuration
document.description: Retrieves a configuration element's definition and its attributes.

document.name: List Configuration Attributes
document.description: Retrieves the attribute values of a configuration element.

document.name: Set Configuration Attribute Value
document.description: Sets the value of a single attribute on a configuration element.

document.name: List Packages
document.description: Lists the packages available in the inventory.

document.name: Get Package
document.description: Retrieves a single package's details and contents.
